content:
maya: Heads-up — my PR to migrate SDK snippets to v2 is stuck. GitHub shows "merge blocked" because CODEOWNERS review is required and the docs-preview check hasn't run. Anyone seen this combo before?
kevin: Can you paste the CODEOWNERS line? order/patterns sometimes bite.
maya: It's just `/docs/** @docs-team` at repo root.
kevin: That pattern is fine. Two likely causes: (1) repo has 'Require review from CODEOWNERS' + an extra team rule so approvals are double-enforced, or (2) the docs-preview check isn't recognized as a required status context for auto-merge.
liam: We can either add the preview check to allowed merge contexts or use an auto-approve flow for trivial docs edits.
maya: Auto-approve feels risky for migration guides. We tried enabling "Allow auto-merge when all required checks pass" but GH complained about permissions — said only users with write can toggle.
kevin: One pragmatic workaround: create a short-lived PR label `docs-quick` that triggers a tiny GH Action to run `gh api repos/:owner/:repo/pulls/:number/reviews` and add an approval from a maintainer bot. Sample action: ```yaml name: docs-auto-approve on: pull_request types: [labeled] jobs: autoapprove: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v3 - uses: hmarr/auto-approve-action@v2 with: github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} ```
maya: If we go that route, does it respect CODEOWNERS? I'm worried it will bypass the intended review gate.
kevin: It will submit an approval as a user/bot. GitHub still enforces CODEOWNERS as a review requirement, but if the bot is allowed to approve (i.e., listed as a reviewer) then it's fine.
docs-bot: CI: docs-preview passed for commit abc123. link-check failed: 2 broken URLs (line 47 and line 103).
maya: I'll fix the links now. Also thinking simpler: narrow the CODEOWNERS pattern to `/docs/snippets/** @docs-team` for the snippet folders so general guide edits don't always need the whole team. Afterwards we can revert.
liam: I'd avoid tweaking CODEOWNERS ad-hoc. I'll check with platform ops about enabling repo-level "Allow auto-merge" for this repo. If ops won't approve, we can land the bot auto-approve + ensure docs-preview is a required check.
maya: Plan: I will fix links, push patch, add `docs-ci` label to trigger the action, and request a manual review from @kevin. If ops approves enabling auto-merge we can flip that on for this repo later.
kevin: SG. Ping me when green and I'll review/approve.
liam: I'll follow up with ops and report back in this thread.
maya: Thanks — updating PR now.
